name: Fetch MLB Team Schedule and Summarize to JSON
prompt:
Use the MLB Stats API (no API key required, base URL: https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1) to fetch schedule data for the New York Yankees (team abbreviation: NYY, team ID: 147) for the week of September 15-21, 2025.

Save the results to schedule_summary.json with exactly these fields:
- team: 'New York Yankees' (string)
- team_id: 147 (integer)
- date_range: { start: '2025-09-15', end: '2025-09-21' } (object with string dates)
- games: array of game objects, each containing:
  - game_pk: MLB game ID (integer)
  - date: date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format (string)
  - home_team: full team name (string)
  - away_team: full team name (string)
  - venue: ballpark name (string)
  - status: game status string (e.g. 'Final', 'Scheduled')
- total_games: count of games in the array (integer)
- home_games: count of games where Yankees are the home team (integer)
- away_games: count of games where Yankees are the away team (integer)

Fetch the schedule from the MLB Stats API schedule endpoint with the appropriate date range and team filter. Ensure total_games = home_games + away_games.

criteria.description: schedule_summary.json file is present in the working directory.
schedule_summary.json parses as valid JSON without throwing an error.
schedule_summary.json contains all 7 required top-level fields: team, team_id, date_range, games, total_games, home_games, away_games.
team is exactly 'New York Yankees' and team_id is exactly 147.
date_range object has start='2025-09-15' and end='2025-09-21' as string values.
games is an array containing at least one game object.
Every game object contains all 6 required fields: game_pk, date, home_team, away_team, venue, and status.
Every game's date string falls within the range 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-21 inclusive.
total_games equals home_games plus away_games, and also equals the length of the games array.
All game_pk values are positive integers (type number, greater than 0, and integer-valued).

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent was asked to fetch the Yankees' schedule for a specific week from the MLB Stats API and summarize it as a JSON file.

Criterion 1: Data Accuracy (Weight: 60%)
1.0: Games listed match real Yankees schedule for Sep 15-21, 2025; all game_pk values are valid MLB integers; home/away split is mathematically consistent.
0.5: Schedule fetched but some games are missing or game details are incomplete.
0: No real schedule data fetched or file is missing.

Criterion 2: Structure Compliance (Weight: 40%)
1.0: All required fields present with correct types; date_range object has start and end strings; total_games equals home_games + away_games.
0.5: Most fields present but a few are missing or have wrong types.
0: Structure is fundamentally wrong.
